name: Lift a vehicle
summary: Every car has a jack, usually a scissor jack in the spare tyre well, and trucks often carry a bottle jack. Car repair shops hold floor jacks and stands nobody thinks to take. Never trust a jack alone: crib the vehicle with solid wood blocks as it rises.

parts.why: Bottle and floor jacks lift a vehicle
Cribbing blocks hold the load safely
A length of pipe over the wrench breaks stuck wheel nuts

tips: Never get under a vehicle held only by a jack. Use stands or stacked hardwood blocks.
Chock the wheels and work on firm, level ground. Put a board under the jack on soft ground.
Loosen wheel nuts before lifting, while the ground stops the wheel turning.
Lift only at the marked jack points. Other spots can bend or slip.
